list_child.name: lsTasks
list_child.desc: This tool returns every turnaround task currently tracked across all flights on the ramp. It includes tasks in every phase from pending through skipped.

get_child.name: getTask
get_child.desc: This tool retrieves a single turnaround task record using its unique identifier. It returns all fields currently stored for that task.

list_parent.name: lsAirlines
list_parent.desc: This tool returns the full list of airlines that ground crew currently services at this station. It includes both mainline and regional carriers.

get_parent.name: getAirline
get_parent.desc: This tool retrieves a single airline record using its unique identifier. It returns the complete airline profile.

delete_child.name: rmTask
delete_child.desc: This tool permanently deletes a turnaround task record from the ramp system. Once removed, the task cannot be recovered by any other tool.

set_enum.name: setTaskPhase
set_enum.desc: This tool changes a turnaround task's phase among pending, in progress, complete, and skipped. It is the standard way ramp crew advance a task through its lifecycle.

set_bool.name: flagCritical
set_bool.desc: This tool flags a turnaround task as safety-critical, meaning the flight cannot depart until it is complete. It is used when ramp supervisors identify a task that blocks departure clearance.

set_ref.name: reassignAirline
set_ref.desc: This tool moves a turnaround task to a different airline, for example after a gate or carrier change. The task's history and phase remain attached to the record.

send.name: notifyAirline
send.desc: This tool sends a notification to the airline associated with a given turnaround task. It is used to relay delays or safety concerns to the carrier's station team.

sort.sup_phrase: the task with the earliest start time
sort.ord_phrase: the task with the {ord} earliest start time
